skills.name: expandRecurrence
skills.card:
expandRecurrence — List the dates a repeating schedule falls on — the first Thursday monthly, every fortnight, every 90 days.
  needs: start: string
  optional: every: string, interval: integer, count: integer, until: string
  e.g. "every fortnight from 2026-09-07, eight times" → {"start":"2026-09-07","every":"week","interval":2,"count":8}

start.label: start date
start.prompt: What date does it start on?

count.label: how many dates
count.description: defaults to 10 without an end date

examples: the 1st of every month for six months from 2026-10-01
my birthday every year from 2026-03-09, four times

skills.name: formatDate

format.label: format
format.prompt: What layout? (YYYY, MM, DD, MMMM for the month name, DDDD for the weekday)

examples: write that date as D MMMM YYYY
show christmas as DDDD, D MMM
format as MM-DD-YY for an american form

skills.name: isWeekend
isoToUnix
skills.card:
isoToUnix — Convert a calendar date and clock time to a Unix epoch number.
  needs: date: string
  optional: time: string
  e.g. "unix timestamp for 2026-09-01" → {"date":"2026-09-01"}

skills.name: isoWeek
examples: which week of the year is christmas 2026

skills.name: nextWeekday
skills.card:
nextWeekday — Find the date of the next Monday, Tuesday and so on — or the most recent one.
  needs: weekday: string
  optional: direction: string, from: string
  e.g. "when is next tuesday" → {"weekday":"Tuesday"}
examples: what date is the next friday

skills.name: timeAgo
readingScheduleFromPages
skills.card:
readingScheduleFromPages — Turn a page count into a daily reading schedule.
  needs: totalPages: integer
  optional: pagesPerDay: integer, days: integer, startDate: string
  e.g. "reading schedule for 60 pages at 20 a day" → {"totalPages":60,"pagesPerDay":20,"startDate":"2026-09-01"}

pagesPerDay.label: pages per day
pagesPerDay.description: how many pages you read a day

startDate.label: start date
startDate.description: the first reading day - today by default

examples: reading schedule for 60 pages at 20 a day
how much should I read a day to finish 100 pages in 4 days
plan 45 pages at 20 pages a day

skills.name: spacedRepetitionSchedule

date.label: date learned
date.description: the day the material was first learned - today by default

intervals.label: review after (days)
intervals.description: days after the start date to review on

examples: spaced repetition schedule doubling each time
review dates one week and one month out
give me a revision plan from today

skills.name: habitCompletionRate

from.label: start date
from.prompt: What is the first day of the period?

examples: how often did I keep this habit
what is my completion rate this week
did I do it every day
completion rate ignoring days outside the period
on what share of days did I keep the streak going
how consistent was I with this over the month
